name: PR Overview shows the derived intent with both scope columns
description: From PR #482's Overview tab, confirm the Intent card renders what was derived: the confidence band, the summary, and the two scope columns — IN SCOPE and OUT OF SCOPE — plus the Recalculate control. The intent is SEEDED, not derived here: classification is the one step of that feature that costs a model call, and no flow may make one. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).

steps.label: open the PR row (by number — the title is CSS-truncated in the list)
navigate to the PR detail route
the band badge renders — never a bare confidence number
the derived summary is on the page
the in-scope column renders (uppercased by CSS, see INSIGHTS.md)
an out-of-scope entry is listed, not just the heading
Recalculate is offered (deliberately not clicked — it would spend a model call)
